title: Zero-credit clean core
summary: YTIntel now boots once into a single stable Analyse/Competitors/Vault shell and completes the 07/09 Monday Brief without paid AI credits.
discord_changes: ONE CLEAN BOOT: removed the layered legacy-version loader that caused the app to flicker between old interfaces.
ZERO-CREDIT ANALYSE: no paid OpenAI/Claude API is used in the normal 17-section Monday Brief flow.
NO MORE 24% DEADLOCK: every source/local stage has a bounded timeout and finishes, blocks honestly, or stops cleanly.
changes: Replaced the legacy multi-script production shell with one v0.34 shell loading one core JavaScript file and one stylesheet.
Analyse follows the MONDAY BRIEF (07/09/26) in the exact 17-section order, ending with the full timestamped transcript.
Sections 2, 3, 14 and 16 use a ready browser on-device language model when available; otherwise they explicitly remain evidence-mode instead of recycling transcript text as AI intelligence.
Public source extraction, hook/re-hook/payoff mapping, Most Replayed, pacing, packaging signals, channel context, competitor tracking and the local vault remain zero-credit.
Progress is task-driven rather than timer-driven and cannot remain indefinitely at 24 percent.
Added source-request and local-model timeouts with explicit STOPPED/BLOCKED states.
Added local creator context for niche, subniche, audience and brand rules.
Added a zero-credit competitor Watchtower using public channel feeds and channel-relative outlier movement.
Added a local niche/subniche vault plus Markdown, transcript copy and browser-PDF export.
Removed automatic paid-model health checks and all old Smart Start, Sprint, Radar, Packaging and commercial presentation layers from the live boot path.
known_limitations: A no-credit website cannot guarantee GPT-5.6/Claude-class cloud reasoning. Deep synthesis is only as strong as the on-device model available in the user's browser.
If no ready local language model exists, sections 2, 3, 14 and 16 show honest evidence-mode fallbacks rather than fabricated synthesis.
Motion-graphics and acoustic claims are withheld unless actual frame/audio evidence is available; the tool does not infer them from captions.
Automated browser acceptance does not replace every physical iPhone/Android configuration.
why_it_matters: The heart of YTIntel is one reliable source-backed analysis flow. Stability and honest evidence come before extra tabs or fake intelligence.
